name: focus-mode
description: Creates a distraction-free listening experience with only album art visible.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run copy && spicetify config extensions focus-mode.js && spicetify apply
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build:dev && npm run copy && spicetify config extensions focus-mode.js && spicetify apply && spicetify enable-devtools
scripts.undeploy: rm -f "$(spicetify path userdata)/Extensions/focus-mode.js" && spicetify config extensions focus-mode.js- && spicetify apply
